parameters.name: backtrack
parameters.description: Set backtrack value (--backtrack).

parameters.name: changed_deps
parameters.description: Tells emerge to replace installed packages for which the ebuild dependencies have changed since the packages were built (--changed-deps). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: changed_use
parameters.description: Include installed packages where USE flags have changed, except when. Flags that the user has not enabled are added or removed. (--changed-use). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: deep
parameters.description: Consider the entire dependency tree of packages (--deep). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: depclean
parameters.description: Remove packages not needed by explicitly merged packages (--depclean). If no package is specified, clean up the world’s dependencies. Otherwise, --depclean serves as a dependency aware version of --unmerge. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: getbinpkg
parameters.description: Prefer packages specified at PORTAGE_BINHOST in make.conf. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: getbinpkgonly
parameters.description: Merge only packages specified at PORTAGE_BINHOST in make.conf. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: jobs
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packages to build simultaneously. Since version 2.6: Value of 0 or false resets any previously added --jobs setting values.

parameters.name: keepgoing
parameters.description: Continue as much as possible after an error. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: loadavg
parameters.description: Specifies that no new builds should be started if there are other builds running and the load average is at least LOAD. Since version 2.6: Value of 0 or False resets any previously added --load-average setting values.

parameters.name: newuse
parameters.description: Include installed packages where USE flags have changed (--newuse). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: nodeps
parameters.description: Only merge packages but not their dependencies (--nodeps). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: noreplace
parameters.description: Do not re-emerge installed packages (--noreplace). Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: oneshot
parameters.description: Do not add the packages to the world file (--oneshot). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: onlydeps
parameters.description: Only merge packages’ dependencies but not the packages (--onlydeps). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Package atom or set, for example sys-apps/foo or >foo-2.13 or @world.

parameters.name: quiet
parameters.description: Run emerge in quiet mode (--quiet). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: quietbuild
parameters.description: Redirect all build output to logs alone, and do not display it on stdout (--quiet-build). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: quietfail
parameters.description: Suppresses display of the build log on stdout (--quiet-fail). Only the die message and the path of the build log are displayed on stdout. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: If set to true, explicitely add the package to the world file. Please note that this option is not used for idempotency, it is only used when actually installing a package. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the package atom. Choices: "present" ← (default) "installed" "emerged" "absent" "removed" "unmerged" "latest"

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description: Sync package repositories first. If yes, perform emerge --sync. If web, perform emerge-webrsync. Choices: "web" "yes" "no"

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: Update packages to the best version available (--update). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: usepkg
parameters.description: Tries to use the binary package(s) in the locally available packages directory. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: usepkgonly
parameters.description: Merge only binaries (no compiling). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Run emerge in verbose mode (--verbose). Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: withbdeps
parameters.description: Specifies that build time dependencies should be installed. Choices: false true

examples:
- name: Make sure package foo is installed
  community.general.portage:
    package: foo
    state: present

- name: Make sure package foo is not installed
  community.general.portage:
    package: foo
    state: absent

- name: Update package foo to the latest version (os specific alternative to latest)
  community.general.portage:
    package: foo
    update: true

- name: Install package foo using PORTAGE_BINHOST setup
  community.general.portage:
    package: foo
    getbinpkg: true

- name: Re-install world from binary packages only and do not allow any compiling
  community.general.portage:
    package: '@world'
    usepkgonly: true

- name: Sync repositories and update world
  community.general.portage:
    package: '@world'
    update: true
    deep: true
    sync: true

- name: Remove unneeded packages
  community.general.portage:
    depclean: true

- name: Remove package foo if it is not explicitly needed
  community.general.portage:
    package: foo
    state: absent
    depclean: true
